summary: Allurion Technologies filed an 8-K on July 21, 2026, reporting entry into an exchange agreement with RTW affiliates (38% holder). Stockholders exchanged 392,766 common shares for pre-funded warrants with a $0.0001 exercise price, under Section 3(a)(9) exemption. The warrants include a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation (adjustable to 19.99%) and terminate automatically upon foreclosure on collateral under existing Revenue Interest Financing Agreements and Convertible Notes, or bankruptcy. This restructuring-like exchange reduces share count without cash consideration, but RTW retains control via debt instruments. Watch for potential foreclosure triggers or further capital structure adjustments, as the warrant termination clause ties directly to creditor actions.
